# Podcast Episode Card

[Film](../README.md) › [Titles & Graphics](../README.md#titles--graphics) · `titles` `podcast` `shapes` `keyframes` `audio` `demo-footage`

A video podcast card with cover art, episode title and an animated waveform over the episode's music.

## About

The opening card of a video podcast episode. The cover art is drawn from shapes (a rounded
orange square with a shadow, a dark disc and a stroked ring) beside the episode number, title
and hosts. The waveform is 24 rounded bars whose Size is keyframed every 0.4 s, so they bounce
for two seconds and land back where they started; the demo project's ambient score plays
under the card on A1.
